title: Flux turns an Android phone or tablet into a second monitor
summary: An independent project by Bjarne Øverli connects an Omarchy computer to a phone. A merged change adds a second screen you can touch.

topics.angle: The phone as a second screen.

claims.text: Flux, an independent project, can use an Android phone or tablet as a second monitor, with touch.
It can also play the computer’s sound on the phone.
